**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User sells handmade jewelry and candles.
- [FACT] User participated in the Spring Fling Market at the downtown park on March 20, 2023.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering positioning their products as more unique and handmade to justify slightly higher prices.
- [EVENT] User had a great conversation with a local boutique owner at the Spring Fling Market.
- [TEMPORAL] Session date is March 21, 2023.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided advice on how to follow up with a potential wholesale customer, including sending a thank-you note, reiterating product benefits, attaching a wholesale catalog, offering a special promotion, showcasing products in a lifestyle setting, and being prepared to answer questions.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested researching competition by identifying competitors, analyzing their prices, noting pricing ranges, and considering their target audience.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended calculating costs, determining pricing objectives, using pricing tiers, testing and adjusting prices, and considering value-based pricing for setting prices.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided a pricing formula for wholesale pricing: Wholesale Price = (Material Cost + Labor Cost + Overheads) x Markup.
- [PREFERENCE] User appreciates detailed advice on pricing strategy.
- [FACT] User noticed that some vendors at the Spring Fling Market had similar products but priced them slightly higher.
- [CHANGE] User is thinking of expanding their product line to include gift sets that bundle jewelry and candles together.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant affirmed that creating gift sets is a good idea and discussed the benefits of gift sets, including convenience, value perception, increased average order value, and cross-selling opportunities.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested pricing gift sets with discounted bundle pricing and value-based pricing.
